description: This script manages the setup and running of a rootless OpenClaw environment within Podman containers. It handles configuration, environment setup, token creation, container lifecycle, and port forwarding for the OpenClaw gateway. The script includes functions for validation, environment variable management, and container orchestration, with specific focus on security and correct configuration within a Linux environment.

methods.name: resolve_user_home
methods.description: Determines the home directory for a given user, using getent or /etc/passwd fallback.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Prints an error message to stderr and exits with status 1.

methods.name: validate_single_line_value
methods.description: Ensures a value does not contain control characters.

methods.name: validate_absolute_path
methods.description: Checks if a path is an absolute path without control characters, repeated slashes, or dot path segments.

methods.name: validate_mount_source_path
methods.description: Validates that a mount source path is an absolute path without colons.

methods.name: ensure_safe_existing_regular_file
methods.description: Ensures a file exists, is not a symlink, and is a regular file.

methods.name: ensure_safe_existing_dir
methods.description: Ensures a directory exists, is not a symlink.

methods.name: stat_uid
methods.description: Retrieves the UID of the file or directory.

methods.name: stat_mode
methods.description: Retrieves the permission mode of the file or directory.

methods.name: ensure_private_existing_dir_owned_by_user
methods.description: Checks that a directory is owned by the current user and not group/world writable.

methods.name: ensure_private_existing_regular_file_owned_by_user
methods.description: Checks that a file is owned by the current user and only owner can write.

methods.name: ensure_safe_write_file_path
methods.description: Validates a path for writing, ensuring the directory exists and is safe.

methods.name: write_file_atomically
methods.description: Writes data to a temp file then moves atomically to target location with specific mode.

methods.name: load_podman_env_file
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a `.env` file, validating contents and exporting variables.

methods.name: validate_port
methods.description: Checks if a port value is a valid number between 1 and 65535.

methods.name: generate_token_hex_32
methods.description: Generates a 32-byte hex token using available tools (openssl, python3, od).

methods.name: create_token_env_file
methods.description: Creates a token environment file with a generated or provided token, setting permissions.

methods.name: sync_local_control_ui_origins_via_cli
methods.description: Syncs the allowed origins for gateway control UI through CLI commands, ensuring no duplicates and proper formatting.

methods.name: sync_local_control_ui_origins
methods.description: Reads and updates JSON config files to include local origins for gateway control UI.

methods.name: upsert_env_var
methods.description: Adds or updates an environment variable in the given env file atomically.
